Name: playground_seed_1
Title: Does adding one quadratic feature fix the moons geometry for logistic regression?
Experiment: Append a synthetic feature x1*x2 (and squared terms) to the two-moons input in experiment.py, keep the LR grid {0.1, 0.3}, and compare test_loss/test_acc against the run_0 baseline over the same 3 trials x 3 seeds.
